versions.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file to reduce duplication.
- No user-facing or feature changes; only internal cleanup.

- Added a Motion brand logo to the documentation for clearer branding.
- Removed the skill-card.md file; all guidance is now consolidated in SKILL.md.
- No changes to core functionality or configuration; documentation only.
Full rewrite to new standard: added tool reference tables, 3-step GIF table, architecture diagram, code examples, error handling, and troubleshooting.

Initial release of motion-planning—integrate Motion with OpenClaw via ClawLink.

- Review tasks, projects, schedules, and planning workflows in Motion from chat.
- Setup guidance for ClawLink pairing and Motion connection without manual Motion API configuration.
- Dynamic tool discovery and usage through ClawLink; no need to know tool names or schemas in advance.
- Built-in rules to ensure secure use—never request raw credentials and always confirm before writes.
- Supports typical Motion operations such as inspecting, creating, or updating tasks according to user permissions.
